ios.desc:
MicroMoment — Apple Watch App for Quick Micro-Resets

Recharge in under two minutes with MicroMoment on Apple Watch. Complete guided micro-resets for breathing, posture, stretching, or a quick energy boost — all with one tap. Designed for fast, watch-first interactions that fit naturally into your day.

Why MicroMoment is unique:
• Adaptive Reset Coach — Get the right micro-reset based on your routine and momentum.
• Streak Rescue — Protect your streak even if you miss a reset.
• Wrist-First Haptic Guidance — Follow exercises with gentle vibrations and glanceable cues.

Key Features:
• Instant Reset Button — Start a micro-moment with a single tap.
• Guided Timers — 30–90 second resets for your Apple Watch.
• Daily Streaks — Build consistency and stay motivated.
• Personalized Suggestions — Receive resets based on your habits and time of day.
• Surprise Mode — Unlock fun, unexpected mini-actions.
• Challenges & Achievements — Complete goals and track progress.
• Watch Face Complication — See your next reset or streak at a glance.

MicroMoment is built for Apple Watch users who want a simple, intelligent way to reset, refocus, and feel better anytime.

Terms of Use: https://micromoment.saposs.com/terms-of-service

show_hn.title: Show HN: MicroMoment Apple Watch micro-resets for focus, posture, and wellbeing

quotes.text:
Hi HN!

I built MicroMoment App, an Apple Watch app designed for 30–90 second micro-resets during the day.

The idea came from noticing how hard it is to maintain focus and good posture while working at a computer for long periods. Instead of long breaks or complicated routines, MicroMoment lets you do tiny actions that reset your mind and body without interrupting your workflow.

With one tap on your watch, it starts a short micro-action like:

a quick stretch

mindful breathing

posture correction

a small energy boost exercise

Everything is designed to be fast, glanceable, and doable in under 2 minutes.

Key features:
- Instant Reset Button – tap once to start a random micro-action
- Timer + haptic guidance – subtle vibrations guide you through the exercise
- Daily streaks – track consistency
- Personalized suggestions based on your usage
- Surprise mode with occasional fun mini-actions
- Challenges & achievements to keep things interesting
- Watch face complication showing your next micro-moment or streak

The goal is simple: help people feel better throughout the workday with minimal friction.

I’d love feedback from the HN community — especially on:

- whether micro-actions like this are actually useful
- features you'd want in a watch-first productivity/wellbeing app
- ideas for new micro-actions

Happy to answer any questions!
